statement: The following statements hold at every finite volume and β > 0. 1. If qΛ is the number of slot edges and c(ω) the number of cycles, then Tr e−βHS,Λ = eβqΛ/4 Eb2c(ω) . 4 The spectral distribution of the total z-spin is obtained by the unpinned color law, assigning +1/2 to each up slot and −1/2 to each down slot at time zero. The expectation, in this normalized color law, of the exponential of β times the field times this sum is the ratio of the field and zero-field partition functions. 2. For the allowed sets E, P and point i above, PE(i ∈ BE) = 2r 1 + r , dE(i) = r 1 + r , r = EP qi. (2.2) 3. More generally, let T be a nonempty finite set of points at one deterministic time, disjoint from an allowed D, and put P′ = D ∪ T. Expose BP′ and let qD,T j be the fresh-walk probability from j ∈ T of hitting T at positive elapsed time before D. Then PD(T ⊂ BD) ≤ (2rT )|T| , rT = 1 |T| X j∈T EP′ qD,T j . (2.3) 4. For any allowed D, the factorial measure of j distinct inter-site marks under PD is bounded by 2j times the base factorial measure. This holds with chronological ordering and with arbitrary deterministic restrictions on the edges and times.
